baseline.tools: public web search allowed; shell/file/agent tools forbidden
assumptions: Chose a silent 1920×1080, 16:9 film with eight scenes, original geometric artwork, kinetic typography, and cream, acid lime, blue, and coral colors. This is an independent creative direction, not a reconstruction of Bento’s brand guidelines.

Product research: [Bento official homepage](https://bento.surf/) supports AI-assisted drafting with user review, scheduling, DM automation, digital products, courses, bookings, memberships, and the connected creator workspace.
Creator-page research: [Bento Link in Bio](https://bento.surf/features/link-in-bio) supports arranging links, media, products, and bookings into a creator website.
All cards and workflows are conceptual illustrations rather than screenshots. No customer identities, pricing, performance statistics, or outcome guarantees are depicted.

No external imagery, fonts, or official logo files are used. The geometric motif is original, and the brand name uses system typography. Public research does not establish a trademark endorsement or brand-asset license.
Uses the harness-provided gsap.min.js. Output has not been rendered or visually reviewed.
baseline.summary: Editable 40-second Bento motion graphic with eight scenes and one deterministic, paused GSAP timeline.
baseline.reason: Rendered and technically checked. Matched-time visual review pending.
baseline.technical_check_limits: Canvas artwork has no DOM text boxes; automated text layout/contrast checks inspected zero text nodes. Visual review is required.
